User.title: User
User.description: Student or administrator profile information and learning tracks.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Full name or screen name of the student.

photoURL.description: Avatar URL of the student profile.

targetTrack.description: Target learning track chosen by the student.

xpPoints.description: Gamified experience points earned through learning.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was created.

ProjectProgress.title: ProjectProgress
ProjectProgress.description: Student milestone completion and test results for a developer project.

projectId.description: Unique identifier of the project (e.g. qkart).

lastPassedMilestone.description: Identifier of the most recent passed milestone.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last test execution.

StudentNote.title: StudentNote
StudentNote.description: Personal student learning note, interview tip, or snippet.

content.description: Markdown or text content of the note.

Application.title: Application
Application.description: Admissions or fellowship application submitted by a student.

userId.description: UID if applicant is logged in, or guest.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual message in a multi-turn conversation with Gemini AI study assistant.

userId.description: Student UID who owns the chat thread.

/users/{userId}.description: User student profiles with role and track preferences.

/users/{userId}/progress/{projectId}.description: Real-time project milestone progress per student.

/users/{userId}/studyNotes/{noteId}.description: Personal student study notes and tips.

/chatSessions/{userId}/messages/{message.description: Persistent Gemini chat messages for the student's conversation thread.
